model_routing.policy: single-model effort routing; model strength is established by calibration, not by name or version

current_main_model.label: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
current_main_model.why: current strongest and cheapest per user calibration; do not infer strength from catalog names

unused_models.reason: V4-Pro; not the main line; wait for V4.1-Pro and run the same calibration A/B before switching

upgrade_policy.trigger: a newer model (for example V4.1-Pro) becomes available
steps: change only model_routing in this file
run the same calibration problem with old and new routes
adopt only if quality is not worse and cost is acceptable
record route_version and A/B evidence in run_report.json
forbidden: hard-code model names in skills, checks, or prompts
adopt a model because of its name or version number alone

model_routing.availability: preflight at INTAKE; if any required model/effort is unavailable, pause; never silently downgrade

quality.description: formal competition; max effort on critical roles; full verification

balanced.description: default practice/normal runs; max on solver/method/reviewer, high on lead/writer/figures

economy.description: draft/low-risk only; high effort everywhere; not for final

freshness_policy.principle: fresh context must inherit the failure dossier, not the old conversation; local fixes resume, root causes go fresh with anti-recurrence evidence

anti_recurrence.similarity_check: compare problem_type/algorithm/model_structure/data_split/objective/subproblem_count against rejected_signature; require new evidence if materially the same
anti_recurrence.regression_rule: every failure_mode needs a runnable acceptance test; the kernel runs it before modeling submit
anti_recurrence.reviewer_rule: reviewer must verify the old failure is addressed using dossier + plan + regression report
anti_recurrence.repeat_failure: escalate to G1/G4; no third fresh attempt without human approval

freshness_policy.decision_owner: kernel suggests; lead may override with reason; human may override at gates; all recorded in run_state.freshness_decisions
freshness_policy.fallback: if the kernel cannot classify, default to fresh_dossier; the human can downgrade

stages.description: create run root, state, event log; verify environment
convert statement, inventory data, recommend track/profile, preflight models and LaTeX
modeling, solving, validation, sensitivity, packaging; no figures; local rework resumes, root rework is fresh+dossier and returns to the earliest stale downstream stage
independent method critique: gate first, then at most two upgrade tickets
conditional human decision; auto-proceed when clean
design cards, hero figures, visual_qa, export PDF+PNG and chart list
mandatory human review of modeling + method + figures
write LaTeX paper, compile PDF, abstract candidates, self-check
mandatory human review of the draft paper before independent review
independent full-text review: 5 dimensions, 12 track checks, red team
fix R1 high-severity issues; expression/consistency only; figure defects forwarded
full re-read after R1; diff anchors, not incremental review
fix R2 high-severity issues
full re-read after R2; residual high goes to G4
conditional human adjudication of residual high severity or compliance waivers
compliance, packaging, MD5, final hygiene; no model judgment
human delivery confirmation
terminal success; run report and cost report
blocked; wait for human decision; no automatic resume
terminal stop; record reason and partial artifacts

gates.notes: track has no default; missing/invalid track must not enter MODELING

gates.auto_rule: verdict=PASS OR (verdict=PASS_WITH_NOTES AND all tickets limitations_only AND recommend.choice=proceed)
gates.notes: auto-proceed is a rule, not a timeout default
approval binds artifact hashes; any change reopens the gate
do not spend a full independent review on a bad draft

gates.auto_rule: review.clean AND no waiver -> COMPLIANCE without G4
gates.notes: accept records explicit residual risk and waiver
submission is an external action; human confirms file list and MD5

roles.notes: orchestrates by state, not by content; never writes professional artifacts
initial fresh; local rework resumes the same child; root rework is fresh with failure dossier + plan gate + regression checks
gate first, then at most two upgrade tickets; recommendation required
design card before drawing; visual_qa; no generated-image reading by the model
durable for R1/R2 continuation; figure defects forwarded, not redrawn
initial fresh; R1 resume for local fixes, fresh for root changes; R2 fresh when fix failure rate >=30% or model changed; full read every round; no method_critique
optional summarizer; the kernel template is authoritative; no professional judgment
deterministic; no model; sole writer of state and evidence
principal; decides G0/G2/G3/G5 and exceptions G1/G4

artifacts.condition: statement contains figures or scanned pages
fresh rework or root-cause review finding
WARN-level auxiliary; produced when paper_tex exists

budgets.stage_token_share_note: initial hypothesis; calibrate after the first run

concurrency.rule: no professional role runs in parallel with its upstream; specialists are serial on the main line

guards.protected_write_policy: deny during RUNNING; changes require a recorded human waiver or post-run calibration
guards.role_write_scopes: advisory; gate-time artifact hashes and human diff are the backstop
guards.freshness_records: run_state.freshness_decisions[] records trigger, mode, reason, scope, child_id, plan_gate, regression, repeat_failure
guards.fallback_mode: manual AGENTS.md protocol with the same check scripts and pipeline_state.json
